summary.headline: Onida Q1 FY27 revenue rose 29.5% YoY to Rs 182.4 crore, but net loss widened to Rs 14.2 crore from Rs 12.5 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations grew 29.5% YoY to Rs 182.4 crore, led by LED TV (+56.8%) and AC (+39.2%) in the branded business of Rs 175 crore (+35.8%). Gross margin improved 100 bps to 17.3%, helped by mix and AC/LED realisations, partly offset by washing machine margin pressure from input costs and competitor pricing. Net loss widened to Rs 14.2 crore from Rs 12.5 crore YoY. Management declined to give revenue or EBITDA guidance or timelines, repeatedly pointing to revenue momentum as the first step and profitability only after scale is reached.

segments.name: Air conditioners
segments.commentary: Largest category, about 60% of Q1 turnover per CFO; grew 39.2% YoY on seasonal recovery and better realisations.

segments.name: LED TVs
segments.commentary: About 25-30% of Q1 turnover; grew 56.8% YoY on launches and promotions. 100-inch QD Mini-LED TV launched and going to market.

segments.name: Washing machines
segments.commentary: Low single-digit share of revenue; down 1.8% YoY on mix, with margins hit by input costs and aggressive competitor pricing. Wider semi-auto and fully-automatic top-load range planned for Diwali.

guidance_outlook: No formal revenue or EBITDA guidance given; management said it would not give forward-looking numbers on this call.
Management said Q1 revenue growth should continue through FY27 and into next year, with bottom line to follow once scale is reached.
When asked about PAT breakeven, CFO said another ~30% increase in revenue from current levels should start contributing to bottom line (ballpark, subject to input costs and competition).
Internal target of 800-1,000 retail-excellence outlets by end of FY27; aim to double retail reach in 6-12 months.
Net working capital benchmark of 30-45 days on an annual average basis; expects no pressing funding need over the next 3-6 months.
Investor PPT to accompany Q2 FY27 results; calls planned at quarter-end results.
capex_capacity: Capex limited to small tooling and mould investments, to be funded internally.
Compressor JV or in-house compressor manufacturing not planned currently because scale does not justify it.
Wada plant scaled down in production; management denied immediate closure but said space may be used for other purposes, with no immediate timeline.
Asset monetisation under review; nothing immediately on the table, though not off the table.
Asset-light model: contract manufacturing deprioritised in favour of own branded business; reliance on ODM/OEM partners, with imports largely minimised due to QCO norms.
demand_pricing: Management said it wants to stay competitive on price while protecting margins; product mix is the other lever.
Early customer response to launches described as encouraging, with conversion rising as retail reach and activation expand.
Offline remains the bulk of revenue; e-commerce is in the high single digits.
Presence through distributors and direct dealers estimated at about 4,000+ stores, stronger in Tier-2/3 and in Gujarat, Punjab, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra and West Bengal.
Institutional cooling is a new vertical that management says has a few good inquiries.
Washing machine pricing pressure from competitors; input costs rising continuously, making frequent price changes difficult.

qa_highlights.question: How will the company handle rising input costs: price competitively or protect margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Management aims to stay competitive on pricing while managing the value chain to protect margins, with product mix as an added lever.

qa_highlights.question: When can PAT break even and what revenue or EBITDA margins are expected?
qa_highlights.answer: No guidance given. CFO said roughly a further 30% revenue increase would start contributing to bottom line, but that is a ballpark that may shift.

qa_highlights.question: What is the segment and channel mix?
qa_highlights.answer: AC about 60% of turnover, LED 25-30%, washing machines low single digit. Online is high single digit, offline is the majority.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company shifting to contract manufacturing?
qa_highlights.answer: Contract manufacturing is now second priority; the branded business is the focus, with own production and some capability maintained.

qa_highlights.question: What is the debt and cash position and are non-core assets being sold?
qa_highlights.answer: Fund-based limits largely unused as of June; borrowings of about Rs 38 crore to be repaid over 18 months; some surplus parked in mutual funds. Asset monetisation under review, nothing immediate.

qa_highlights.question: What is the working capital benchmark?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 30-45 net working capital days on an annual average is a good benchmark, with seasonal elevation expected.

risks_watch: Margin pressure: washing machine margins under competitor pricing; input costs rising with limited ability to pass on.
Loss widened YoY despite revenue growth; the path to PAT breakeven remains undefined.
Balance sheet described as slightly stressed by management; asset monetisation (Andheri office, Wada land and plant) not yet decided.
Execution of retail expansion (double reach in 6-12 months; 800-1,000 excellence outlets) and funding of marketing and GTM spend.
Festive season (Diwali/Dussehra) performance of new TV and washing machine launches.
Service quality and reputation ahead of planned service infrastructure improvements.
Leadership transition: management says the team is fully in place but further changes are expected.
summary.management_tone: Confident on revenue momentum and the strategy narrative, but cautious and evasive on profitability, timelines and numerical targets, which management repeatedly declined to give. Financial answers were brief and deferred to future quarters.
key_quotes: So, during Q1 Financial Year’ 27, our branded business stood at Rs. 175 crores that recorded 35.8% year-on-year growth, primarily driven by strong performance in our LED TV and AC categories.
We remain focused on improving our profitability and operational performance, including working capital going forward.
And our objective is to continue this momentum for the rest of the year as well as for the next coming year.
So, going forward, during this Diwali, we will have a much stronger range in washing machines than what we have currently.

financial_highlights.change: +29.5% YoY (vs Rs 140.9 crore in Q1 FY26)
Loss widened from Rs 12.5 crore in Q1 FY26
Supported by new launches and promotions
Repayment over next 18 months; fund-based limits largely unutilised as of June

adds.what: Small tooling and mould investments, internally funded (no capacity addition sized)

growth.why: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 29.5% YoY to Rs 182.4 crore, but management gave no formal revenue guidance, capex is limited to small tooling, the Wada plant production was scaled down, and asset-light strategy means no major capacity coming live.
